english.title: Pedestrian / cyclist remain within limits of a parallel crossing longer than was necessary
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a

(A)_[pedestrian,]_
(B)_[cyclist,]_

remained on the carriageway within the limits of a Parallel crossing on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) longer than was necessary for you to pass over the crossing with reasonable despatch
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 21(1)(b), part 1, Schedule 14 of the Traffic Signs Regulation and General Directions 2016, section 25(5) of the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes: The Zebra, Pelican and Puffin Pedestrian Crossings Regulations 1997 were repealed from 22nd April 2016. However, these regulations remain in force in relation to Pelican crossings only, providing they were established prior to 22nd October 2016 (6 months from the date of repeal) by virtue of regulation 14(5) of the Traffic Signs Regulations and General Directions 2016.
